SSRM.physical_anchor: Doré gold bars and silver-lead-zinc concentrate poured/produced at its own open-pit and underground mines (Çöpler, Marigold, Seabee, Puna).
SSRM.value_chain_position: Mid-tier producer layer — mines and pours its own gold with silver/zinc/lead byproduct credits from Puna.

STLD.physical_anchor: Steel bar, plate and coil melted in electric-arc-furnace mini-mills from purchased scrap and iron feedstocks — not ore or concentrate.
STLD.value_chain_position: Steel converter — buys scrap/iron inputs and sells finished steel products; does not sell ore or concentrate.

SVM.physical_anchor: Silver-lead-zinc concentrate and doré mined at its Ying Mining District (China) underground mines, plus early copper-zinc-gold-silver concentrate from El Domo (Ecuador).
SVM.value_chain_position: Silver-primary mid-tier producer with meaningful base-metal byproduct credits.

TECK.physical_anchor: Copper concentrate (QB2, Highland Valley) and zinc concentrate (Red Dog) shipped from its own mines.
TECK.value_chain_position: Diversified base-metal major transitioning to a copper-weighted mix, still carrying a large zinc business.

TX.physical_anchor: Flat and long finished steel products (sheet, plate, rebar) rolled from a mix of purchased and captive iron-ore/scrap feedstock across Latin American mills — sells steel, not ore.
TX.value_chain_position: Integrated steel converter selling finished steel products, not ore/concentrate.

VALE.physical_anchor: Iron-ore fines and pellets mined in Brazil and shipped as bulk ore to steelmakers, plus nickel and copper concentrate.
VALE.value_chain_position: Bulk/base-metal major selling raw ore and concentrate (iron ore primary, nickel/copper secondary) — the one 'Steel'-classified name that actually belongs here.

WPM.physical_anchor: Streamed gold, silver and palladium bullion delivered under long-term offtake/streaming agreements with third-party mine operators.
WPM.value_chain_position: Royalty & streaming layer — funds mine capex for a fixed share of metal output, no operating costs carried.

ABAT.physical_anchor: Recycled lithium-ion battery black mass and recovered nickel/cobalt/lithium materials from its Nevada recycling facility, plus an early-stage lithium (claystone) extraction project — not a producing mine on any chain here.
ABAT.value_chain_position: Battery-materials recycler/developer; lithium and recycled battery metals are not covered by any chain in this taxonomy (uranium, copper, precious metals, rare-earth/strategic, diversified majors).

ALB.physical_anchor: Lithium hydroxide and lithium carbonate extracted from brine (Salar de Atacama) and hard-rock spodumene (Greenbushes) and processed into battery-grade chemicals.
ALB.value_chain_position: Lithium miner/chemical producer — a genuine mined-commodity business, but lithium is not a defined chain in this taxonomy (rare_earth_strategic covers rare earths/antimony/gallium/tungsten only); caught by the Chemicals-Specialty industry filter.

ALM.physical_anchor: Tungsten concentrate mined and processed at Sangdong (South Korea) and Panasqueira (Portugal).
ALM.value_chain_position: Pure-play tungsten miner — the strategic-metal chokepoint the chain thesis is built on.

ALOY.physical_anchor: Uncertain — no verifiable producing mine or metal-processing output could be confirmed for this recently-classified 'Other Precious Metals' name (revenue of $2.5M against a $100M EBITDA loss is inconsistent with an operating mine).
ALOY.value_chain_position: Insufficient verified information to place in a value-chain layer; treat as unconfirmed until a physical anchor is verified.

ALTO.physical_anchor: Fuel-grade and specialty ethanol/alcohol distilled from corn at its Pacific Northwest and Midwest plants — no mined commodity.
ALTO.value_chain_position: Corn ethanol/specialty-alcohol producer; caught by the Chemicals-Specialty industry filter, not a mining-chain participant.

APD.physical_anchor: Industrial gases (hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, argon) produced via air-separation and steam-methane-reforming units and piped/trucked to customers under long-term supply contracts.
APD.value_chain_position: Industrial-gas utility-style supplier; no mined commodity exposure, caught by the Chemicals-Specialty filter.

ASH.physical_anchor: Specialty chemical additives and cellulosic/pharma excipients manufactured from petrochemical and biobased feedstocks — no mined commodity.
ASH.value_chain_position: Specialty chemicals producer, unrelated to any mining chain; caught by the Chemicals-Specialty filter.

ASPN.physical_anchor: Aerogel insulation blankets and panels manufactured for EV battery thermal barriers and energy-infrastructure insulation — a manufactured material, not a mined commodity.
ASPN.value_chain_position: Materials manufacturer selling insulation components into EV/industrial supply chains; no mining-chain exposure.

ASTL.physical_anchor: Steel plate and coil rolled from purchased iron-ore pellets/scrap at its Sault Ste. Marie mill — sells finished steel, not ore.
ASTL.value_chain_position: Integrated steel converter, same discriminator as STLD/TX/CLF — no ore/concentrate sold.

CC.physical_anchor: Titanium dioxide pigment and fluoropolymer/refrigerant chemicals (Opteon, Teflon) manufactured from mineral and petrochemical feedstocks — not a mined commodity itself.
CC.value_chain_position: Specialty/industrial chemicals producer; caught by the Chemicals-Specialty filter, not a mining-chain participant.

CLF.physical_anchor: Hot-rolled, cold-rolled and specialty steel products made largely from its own captive iron ore, but sold as finished steel, never as ore or concentrate.
CLF.value_chain_position: Vertically integrated steelmaker with captive ore — explicitly the naive-extraction-test trap: revenue source is finished steel, not ore, so it is a converter, however integrated.

CLMT.physical_anchor: Specialty petroleum lubricants, waxes and renewable diesel refined from crude and biobased feedstocks — no mined commodity.
CLMT.value_chain_position: Specialty petroleum-products refiner, unrelated to any mining chain; caught by the Chemicals-Specialty filter.

CMP.physical_anchor: Rock salt mined at its Goderich (Ontario) and Kansas underground mines, plus sulfate-of-potash fertilizer produced from Great Salt Lake brine evaporation ponds.
CMP.value_chain_position: Genuine miner (salt and potash) but neither commodity is covered by any chain in this taxonomy (no salt/agri-mineral chain defined); caught by the Industrial Materials filter.
